principle: Make the dashboard feel as smooth as ChatGPT, with signed provenance.

improvements.name: Empty states
improvements.scope: Every pane shows what to do when there's no data yet

improvements.name: Onboarding tour
improvements.scope: First-time user gets a guided tour of all panes

improvements.name: Tooltips + keyboard shortcuts
improvements.scope: Every action has a tooltip + keyboard shortcut

improvements.name: Loading skeletons
improvements.scope: Every pane has skeletons while data loads

improvements.name: Error states
improvements.scope: Graceful failures. Every error has a signed receipt.

improvements.name: Toast notifications
improvements.scope: Real-time feedback. Every toast emits a signed event card.

improvements.name: Accessibility audit (WCAG 2.1 AA)
improvements.scope: Every pane meets WCAG 2.1 AA (color contrast, ARIA, keyboard nav)

improvements.name: Performance audit
improvements.scope: Every pane FCP < 1s on 4G. Bundle size < 500KB gzipped.

improvements.name: Search + filtering
improvements.scope: Search across all panes. Filter by date, kind, model, axis.

improvements.name: Bulk operations
improvements.scope: Multi-select. Bulk sign, bulk export, bulk share.

improvements.name: Drag and drop
improvements.scope: Reorder panes. Drag files into panes. Drag URLs into chat.

improvements.name: Inline editing
improvements.scope: Edit anything inline. Every edit emits a signed event.

improvements.name: Undo / redo
improvements.scope: Every action has undo (signed). Every redo emits a new signed event.

improvements.name: Export to PDF / CSV
improvements.scope: Every pane exports to PDF or CSV. The export itself is signed.
